errors.evidence: The blue sector, labeled "До 5%" (Up to 5%), has a value of 22.1% shown on the chart, not 5%. The model misinterpreted the category label as the value.
The yellow sector has a value of 11.8% as indicated on the chart, not 22.1%. The value 22.1% belongs to the blue sector.

errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. The values are 42.6%, 23.5%, 22.1%, and 11.8%, but their placement on the chart does not follow a sorted order.
